title: Timestamp source: Raft-replicated TSO (TASK-0009)
rationale: From docs/design/transactions.md in the ds-core repo. TSO makes serializability independent of clock skew, which REQ-0014 AC2's clock nemesis tests on every release; v1 is single-region so the TSO round trip is same-region and batchable.

data.title: Raft-replicated timestamp oracle (TSO) as the transaction timestamp source
data.context: TASK-0009 compared a centralised TSO (Percolator/TiDB style) with HLC plus uncertainty intervals (CockroachDB style). REQ-0014 AC2 requires 0 anomalies under clock skew; v1 is single-region (AZ-level placement, REQ-0001).
data.decision: Transactions take start_ts and commit_ts from a strictly monotonic TSO on the meta-range leaseholder, persisting a high-water mark through Raft and serving batched timestamps from memory. Combined with Percolator-style prewrite and commit-time read-set validation this gives (strict) serializability with no dependence on clock synchronisation. Revisit if multi-region writes become a requirement.
